title: BC Vision ANPR V1/V2 Accuracy Manifest
description: Operator-verified local inputs used byte-for-byte unchanged for both engines. Strict evidence describes byte/provenance integrity: explicit inference-only policy and label provenance plus a local relative media path, media type, SHA-256 digest, and byte size for every input. Category completeness, multi-event coverage, exhaustive labels, and negative samples are tracked separately.

dataset_fingerprint_sha256.description: Deterministic logical dataset identity written by prepare_engine_v2_accuracy_dataset.py.

training_allowed.description: Accuracy evidence is inference-only and must never be admitted to training.

coverage.description: Coverage inventory written by the dataset preparer.

template.description: Must be false or absent for a benchmark run. Template manifests are rejected as evidence.

id.description: Opaque manifest bookkeeping ID. Do not embed plate text or other label hints.

path.description: Final strict evidence uses a local content-addressed media/<sha256><suffix> path relative to the manifest directory. URIs, absolute paths, parent traversal, and every symlink/junction component are rejected.

sha256.description: Media identity re-hashed immediately before V1, between engines, and immediately after V2.

size_bytes.description: Exact media byte size checked at every integrity boundary.

expected_plate.description: Verified plate text, or null only when an exhaustive review verified rejection/unreadable. known_positives never permits null.

expected_events.description: Verified event set for multi-vehicle/video samples. Each event may carry a matching time window.

label_status.description: The runner accepts only verified. Pending is allowed solely so the supplied template can be edited and schema-checked before evidence collection.

label_scope.description: exhaustive means all events are labelled. known_positives permits honest partial recall/CER evidence but makes exact-set, precision, false-positive, and duplicate metrics unavailable.
